objective: Replace the coarse p*q maximum-length DP bound with a polynomial structure-aware raw-resolvent upper bound and test whether the frozen reachability invariant closes on actually reachable residuals.

frozen_transition_bound.name: EXACT_NONTAUTOLOGICAL_RAW_RESOLVENT_BOUND
frozen_transition_bound.definition: For a pivot x, keep every pivot-free base clause exactly. For every positive-parent/negative-parent pair, form the exact merged resolvent after removing x and -x; discard the pair if the merged resolvent is tautological; otherwise count exactly one raw resolvent with its exact deduplicated literal length. Do not use clause deduplication or subsumption in this bound. Let RAW_C and RAW_L be base plus these raw resolvents and RAW_S=RAW_C+RAW_L.
frozen_transition_bound.soundness_claim_to_test: Canonical exact-DP NF (deduplication + strict subsumption) can only remove clauses/literals from the raw non-tautological resolvent collection, therefore S_exact_after <= RAW_S.
frozen_transition_bound.complexity_contract: Computing RAW_S scans parent pairs and merged literals only; it is polynomial in the explicit current formula size and the explicit parent-pair count.

frozen_invariant.interpretation: If the raw bound satisfies both post-transition inequalities, then the canonical exact-DP result also satisfies them because S_exact_after <= RAW_S.

domain.selection: Use the same analytic scheduler and reachable residual events as AF; pivot choice remains truth-blind.

success_condition: All checked reachable residual transitions satisfy S_exact_after <= RAW_S and at least one truth-blind selectable pivot per residual satisfies the frozen post-invariant conditions, with independent exact-DP replay and no semantic mismatch.
